newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes firmer on client forex sales.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes firmer on client forex sales.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev firmed to 978-981 per mark at the close from the opening's 981-984, due to increased foreign currency sales from clients for pending lev payments, dealers said.
* The lev closed at 1,697-1,700 per dollar, up from the morning's 1,702-1,704 and in line with the international mark/dollar cross.
* Traders adjusted lev/dollar rates to the lev/mark ahead of a currency board peg of 1,000 levs per mark from July 1.

* Foreign currency supply topped demand despite falling yield on benchmark four-week discount T-bills, which was expected to result in a cut in the central bank main interest rate, now set at 35.76 percent annually.
* The average yield to maturity on the paper fell to 0.62 percent at today's auction from 0.69 percent on Wednesday and 0.72 percent on Tuesday.
